title: ELSE IF - Multiple Conditions
description: Chain multiple conditions using ELSE IF for multi-way decisions.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, what if there are MORE than two options? ELSE IF lets you check multiple conditions in sequence."
story.context: ELSE IF adds additional condition checks. Robot Framework tests them in order until one is TRUE, or falls through to ELSE.

instructions: Note: Checks conditions in order, runs first TRUE match
hints: ELSE IF is at same level as IF
Can have multiple ELSE IF statements

ELSE catches everything not matched above

Power Level Classification
    ${power}=    Set Variable    45
    IF    ${power} >= 80
        Log    Power level: OPTIMAL
    ELSE IF    ${power} >= 50

theory.title: Exercise 2.3.3: ELSE IF
theory.content:
🪜 The Decision Ladder

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, life isn't binary. Sometimes you need multiple options: Optimal, Good, Low, Critical. That's ELSE IF."

"Think of it as a ladder. Check the top condition first. If FALSE, step down. Check next. Keep going until you find a TRUE or hit ELSE at the bottom."

🔄 What is ELSE IF?

ELSE IF - Additional condition checks in a decision chain

  • ✅ Multiple conditions - More than two options
  • ✅ Sequential checking - Test from top to bottom
  • ✅ First match wins - Stop at first TRUE
  • ✅ Mutually exclusive - Only ONE block runs

Execution Order:

  1. 🔹 Check IF condition → TRUE? Run block, skip rest
  2. 🔹 Check ELSE IF #1 → TRUE? Run block, skip rest
  3. 🔹 Check ELSE IF #2 → TRUE? Run block, skip rest
  4. 🔹 All FALSE? Run ELSE block (if present)

📝 ELSE IF Syntax

*** Test Cases ***
Grade Assignment
    ${score}=    Set Variable    75
    IF    ${score} >= 90
        Log    Grade: A
    ELSE IF    ${score} >= 80
        Log    Grade: B
    ELSE IF    ${score} >= 70
        Log    Grade: C
    ELSE IF    ${score} >= 60
        Log    Grade: D
    ELSE
        Log    Grade: F
    END

Execution (score=75):

  1. 🔹 75 >= 90? FALSE, skip
  2. 🔹 75 >= 80? FALSE, skip
  3. 🔹 75 >= 70? TRUE! → Log "Grade: C", STOP

📋 ELSE IF Rules

  • 🔹 Position: After IF, before ELSE
  • 🔹 Multiple: Can have unlimited ELSE IF statements
  • 🔹 Order matters: Checked sequentially top to bottom
  • 🔹 Exclusive: Only FIRST true condition executes
  • 🔹 ELSE optional: Can end with ELSE IF without ELSE

🎯 Your Task

Create a power classifier with 4 levels: OPTIMAL (>=80), GOOD (>=50), LOW (>=20), CRITICAL (else). Multiple conditions, one winner!
